policies.text: Pharmaceutical distribution endorsement is granted when a pharmacy holds a State Board License credential.
Oversight staffing criteria are met whenever an institution retains a compliance officer count of 4 or more.
Staff compliance readiness is recognized when an organization completes 10 or more clinical training modules per quarter while maintaining at least 3 compliance officers.
Data privacy benchmark is satisfied if a healthcare provider records 3 or fewer privacy violations per year.
Regional care center status is awarded to any facility that maintains quality assurance accreditation and obtains facility license renewal.
Master service contract eligibility is confirmed when an institution obtains regulatory compliance clearance and secures tier-one healthcare status.
Community triage clearance is granted when an emergency team deploys 10 mobile rescue vehicles and sustains dispatch times under 5 minutes.

Regulatory compliance clearance is conferred either if an entity completes 12 or more clinical training modules per quarter while recording 5 or fewer privacy violations per year, or holds a State Quality Seal credential.
Tier-one healthcare status is designated when an organization ensures oversight staffing criteria are met and holds full operational clearance.
Safety monitoring mandate is fulfilled when a provider completes 10 or more safety inspections per year.
Acute care capacity threshold is reached when a facility maintains an intensive care bed count of 6 or more.
Facility license renewal is approved for any center holding a risk management credential alongside a facility safety rating of 90 points or greater.
Full operational clearance is granted when an entity fulfills clinical governance requirements and receives an audit score of 90 percent or greater.
Community wellness grant eligibility requires an organization to complete 15 outreach programs per year and maintain a patient satisfaction score of 85 points or higher.
Quality assurance accreditation is granted either if an organization maintains a compliance officer count of 4 or higher, or holds ISO 27001 certification.
High-volume facility status is recognized when a clinic registers 300 or more monthly patient admissions.
A risk management credential is awarded provided that data privacy benchmarks are met and the emergency preparedness rating reaches 80 percent or above.
